name: FormTask
caption: Form task

configuration.description: What the person should fill in and why. Shown above the form. Supports SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]] and SmartControls {#..#}. The task's subject is the step's description (fallback: the flow's description), not this text.

0 = a single user, 1 = a task group (any member can complete it). The editor always writes it. Any value other than 1 is treated as a user. There is no 'user who started the flow' option (2) for form tasks.

assignType 0: a Business Central user name (or user security ID). assignType 1: a task group code. Matched case-insensitively after trimming. Can be a SmartField resolved when the step runs. Assigning needs no AutoFlow Tasks seat; completing does.
Optional. A date (yyyy-mm-dd is safest) or a SmartDate. Overdue tasks are highlighted in the inbox. A value that does not resolve to a date is ignored silently.
Rows of { caption, name, kind, rowsFrom, allowAdd }. Optional: fields without a section go into a section without a heading at the top of the form. The editor always writes the array.
Heading of the section on the task card.

How fields (fields[].section) and outputs refer to the section; a repeater's outputs are <name> and <name>Count. Letters and digits, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters, unique across all field and section names (case-insensitive). Not checked when the flow is saved or published. The editor fills an empty name from the caption (camelCase).
normal = fields one below the other; repeater = a table the person fills in row by row. Anything other than 'repeater' counts as normal.

Repeater only: exactly one SmartField placeholder '{{name}}' pointing to records or values (a reference, an array, an iterator), read in its raw form. One prefilled row per entry, at most 1,000. Empty: the repeater starts without rows.
Repeater only: true lets the person add and delete rows; false keeps the prefilled rows as they are.

Rows of { section, caption, name, type, required, value, options, freeText, tableNo, filters }. At least one field is needed (else the task cannot be created). The editor always writes the array and every column of a row.
The name of the section the field belongs to. Empty (or a name that does not exist) = the section without a heading at the top.
Label of the field on the task card.

Output name of the field. Letters and digits, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters, unique across all field and section names (case-insensitive). Not checked when the flow is saved or published. The editor fills an empty name from the caption (camelCase: 'Delivery date' -> deliveryDate); always set it in hand-written JSON.
Field type. Empty counts as text.
true: the task can only be completed once the field is filled in.

Prefill, SmartText resolved when the task is created (SmartFields, SmartFormulas, SmartDates). In a repeater, a prefill that starts with the section's rowsFrom name ({{FindCust_results.name}} for rowsFrom {{FindCust_results}}) is resolved per row; any other prefill is the same in every row. type reference: exactly one '{{name}}' placeholder holding a record (the first of an array); anything else prefills nothing.
type dropdown only: the values, separated by ';' or line breaks. SmartText; an entry that is exactly one SmartField holding an array adds each of its values.
type dropdown only: true also accepts values that are not in the list.
type reference only: the table whose records the field offers (matching filters, primary-key order, at most 1,000). 0 for other types.
type reference only: [{ "fieldNo": <field no. of tableNo>, "filter": "<filter expression>" }]; filter supports SmartText and is resolved when the task is created. [] = no filter.
0 = no preview, 1 = HTML (previewHtml), 2 = document (previewDocument).

previewKind 1: HTML with SmartFields, rendered live on the card (not a snapshot). Can use earlier steps' outputs and the form's own fields as {{<slug>_<field>}}; a repeater's rows with {#for {{<slug>_<section>}} #}...{{<slug>_<section>.<column>}}...{#endfor#} and {{<slug>_<section>Count}}.

previewKind 2: exactly one '{{name}}' placeholder pointing to an incoming document attachment or an AutoFlow document - can be one of the form's own record fields ({{<slug>_<field>}}), so the preview follows the person's choice.

outputs.name: <field name>
outputs.when: once completed - one per field of a normal section (including the top section), named by fields[].name; text in XML format (true/false, 12, 1.25, 2026-11-02, 2026-11-02T09:30:00)

outputs.name: <field name>
outputs.when: once completed, when the record field was filled in - fields of type reference in a normal section; the chosen record

outputs.name: <section name>
outputs.when: once completed, when the repeater has rows - one per repeater section: its rows as SmartObjects (table 5564267 mse365 SK SmartObject), {{slug_section}} = the first row, {{slug_section[i]}} = the i-th (0-based); columns = the section's fields ({{slug_section.column}}). The declared output carries "columns": [{ name, type: value|reference, tableNo (reference only) }], one per field of the section in fields order - Read task repeater and For Each take them over

outputs.name: <section name>Count
outputs.when: once completed - one per repeater section: number of rows

outputs.name: completedBy
outputs.when: once completed - user name of who completed the task

outputs.name: task
outputs.when: once completed - the task record (table 5564323 mse365 AF-CO Task)

notes: Dark-launched: only available where AutoFlow Tasks (portal feature flag 'tasks') is enabled for the environment. Elsewhere the step is hidden in the editor and publish refuses it.

The flow waits in the background like the Approval task: parked, checked every poll interval (AutoFlow Setup 'Task Poll Interval (Min.)', default 5 minutes), and continued immediately when the user the flow runs as completes the task themselves. Each loop pass creates its own task; a retried run reuses the task it created.
Completing (and saving a draft of) a form task needs a paid AutoFlow licence and an AutoFlow Tasks seat. Assigning needs no seat.
In a Webhook flow with WaitForResponse, put the step after Respond to Webhook: in the synchronous phase the step cannot park and fails.

The form is a snapshot taken when the task is created: prefills, dropdown values, the records a record field offers (at most 1,000) and the prefilled repeater rows (at most 1,000). Only the preview is rendered live.

The step's own design-time checks are not run: 'The name '%1' is used more than once. Field and section names must be unique.', 'The name '%1' is not valid: use letters and digits only, at most %2 characters, starting with a letter.', 'The field '%1' is in section '%2', which does not exist.', 'Choose the table of the record field '%1'.', 'Enter the values of the dropdown '%1'.', 'The prefill of '%1' must use the rows of its section, for example {{%2.Name}}.', 'The repeater section '%1' has no fields.', 'Choose the document the preview shows.' Follow these rules anyway.
Fields of a repeater section have no outputs of their own: read them through the repeater output, a For Each over it, or Read task repeater. Output names are cut at 30 characters.

On the card, Complete checks required fields and refuses values it cannot read (dates, numbers), dropdown values not offered (unless freeText) and records not in the list. Save draft keeps the entries, the task stays open.
